item.description: The A427 was blocked near Brampton Ash today after a lorry jack-knifed and became stuck. item.description: A new private medical centre could be coming to Market Harborough. item.title: New Homes Planned for Former Army Cadet Site
item.description: Plans have been submitted to demolish a former Army Cadet Force building in Market Harborough to make way for new homes. The proposals include five three-storey townhouses on Yeomanry Court, off Coventry Road, with associated gardens and car parking. item.title: Residents Have Their Say on Proposed Town Council
item.description: People in Market Harborough are having their say on whether the town should have its own council. A public consultation is underway ahead of a final decision.
